Arthur looked back toward the towering beacon.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市退去了白日的喧嚣，整座钢铁森林在墨蓝色的夜幕下沉睡。街道空旷而寂寥，唯有橘黄色的路灯静静投下斑驳的光影。偶尔有一辆夜班出租车悄然滑过路口，划破清冷的空气。远处的便利店透出微弱温暖的光芒，环卫工人已经挥起扫帚，在微凉的晨风中默默唤醒沉睡的街巷。", "w03": "• Recursion is like standing between two mirrors and seeing smaller and smaller reflections of yourself forever.\n• In computer code, it means a task solves a big puzzle by calling itself to solve a tinier version of the exact same puzzle.\n• It always needs a simple stop rule so it knows when the job is completely finished and doesn't keep running forever."}
